title: Advanced Computer Networks
weeklyTopics: Video streaming and adaptive bitrate algorithms
Datacenter traffic optimization with deep reinforcement learning
Switch software and FPGA datacenter resources
TCP congestion control and machine intelligence
CDN geoblocking and global network measurement
IoT noise cancellation and video analytics scaling
Container overlay networking and datacenter RPCs
Internet outage detection and interdomain congestion
skills: reading and critiquing networking research papers
workloadNotes: Seminar-style graduate course: ~50 research papers read/discussed over the semester (from SIGCOMM, MobiCom, NSDI, IMC), each led by a student presenter (individually or in groups). Semester-long research project (analysis, design, and/or implementation) with a mid-semester progress presentation and a final poster session. Graded on paper reviews, class discussion, and project scope/effort/results; students who satisfactorily complete all assigned work receive a B+ or better.
prerequisitesText: Good programming skills and at least one undergraduate systems-related course (operating systems, databases, distributed systems, or networking).
